Transforms per-wheel vectors through the wheel-space rotation matrix (this:0x34B0..0x34D0) plus the world-space position offset (this:0x34D4..0x34DC), computes steer cross products from the fields at float indices 3390..3395, derives cos/sin of the product this[3672] * this[3421] and stores them in several slots (this:0x363C/0x3640/0x3734/0x3738, plus the raw angle in this:0x35A8/0x36A0). Runs TireContactForceComputation and WheelSpringDamperForceAndSteering per wheel, applies a body-roll torque redistribution gated on this:0x34C0 > 0.69999999, damps per-wheel values, and accumulates forces/torques into this:0x354C..0x3560 which are then distributed back into per-wheel slots. Returns a pointer into the wheel array.

functions.name: transformWithTranslation
functions.summary: Transforms a local offset vector (this+0x3B54, the rigid-body contact/attachment point) by the 3x3 rotation matrix (this+0x34B0), adds the body world position translation (this+0x34D4), and stores the world-space result at this+0x3B60. A standard rigid-body point transform used by the suspension/contact and AI path systems.

operations.description: World-space X result (this+0x3B60) = row-0 dot product of the local offset vector (this+0x3B54/+0x3B58/+0x3B5C) with rotation elements this+0x34B0/+0x34B4/+0x34B8, plus the X translation this+0x34D4.
World-space Y result (this+0x3B64) = row-1 dot product of the local offset vector with rotation elements this+0x34BC/+0x34C0/+0x34C4, plus the Y translation this+0x34D8.
World-space Z result (this+0x3B68) = row-2 dot product of the local offset vector with rotation elements this+0x34C8/+0x34CC/+0x34D0, plus the Z translation this+0x34DC.

functions.name: CollisionSparkParticleEffects
functions.summary: Per-frame collision visual/damage feedback for the vehicle: gated by vehicle identity (this[0] vs dword_7C54E8) and a restricted-mode/race-phase guard (this[0x32BC], dword_7C56A8), it scales the impact impulse, fires spark/damage events into a ring buffer (ProgressBarEventEncode + StateTransition), runs two body-zone repair-service blocks and an 8-zone body loop plus a 4-zone wheel loop that dispatch ShortComputation/RepairService events, and applies steering-geometry deformation (SteeringGeometryUpdate) and tire-scrub reset (TireScrubReset) on severe impacts. Called per frame from VehicleContactForceAccumulation.

operations.description: Primary path requires this[0] == dword_7C54E8 (vehicle identity matches the shared reference).
Primary path also requires byte_7C749F clear and (byte at this[0x3440] clear or byte_7C74A4 clear).
When identity differs, the main body runs if the restricted-mode flag this[0x32BC] != 1, or if the race phase dword_7C56A8 is not 1 and not 3.

Impact magnitude v115 = |a4|; scaled force v146 = dword_7D0014 * v115 * 0.0099999998; ramped through this[0x3D78] + this[0x3D7C]*v146 and clamped to this[0x3D80]; squared into the proximity threshold v113.
When the scaled force v146 exceeds this[0x3D84], TireScrubReset(this) clears the tire-scrub state.

v8 = this[0x3D90] * damage clamped to 1.0; v9 = sqrt(v8) / |a4|; spark direction components v118/v119/v120 = a3 components scaled by v9.

functions.name: transformCoordinateWithOffset
functions.summary: Transforms a coordinate vector: builds a 3x3 rotation matrix from Euler input a3 via EulerToRotationMatrix, computes the ride-height delta 3-vector via RideHeightDelta, rotates that delta by the matrix, adds the position offset at this+0x34D4..0x34DC, and writes into a4 the difference between (a2 + position offset) and the transformed vector. On the per-frame physics path.

operations.description: Invoke EulerToRotationMatrix(a3, v17) to convert the Euler angles in a3 into the 3x3 rotation matrix stored in v17.
Invoke RideHeightDelta(this, &v13) to compute the ride-height delta 3-vector into v13/v14/v15.
Rotate the ride-height delta by the rotation matrix: v5 = v17[0]*v13 + v17[1]*v14 + v17[2]*v15, v6 = v17[3]*v13 + v17[4]*v14 + v17[5]*v15, v15 = v17[6]*v13 + v17[7]*v14 + v17[8]*v15.
Add the position offset to the rotated delta: v13 = v5 + this[3381], v7 = v6 + this[3382], v8 = v15 + this[3383], reading offset components at this+0x34D4..0x34DC.
Build the comparison vector from a2 plus the same position offset: v9 = this[3381] + a2[0], v10 = this[3382] + a2[1], v16 = this[3383] + a2[2].
Compute and store the output vector: a4[0] = v9 - v13, a4[1] = v10 - v7, a4[2] = v16 - v8.
Return LODWORD(v14), the low DWORD of the y-component; an x87 codegen artifact rather than a meaningful value.
